description: District 8 of the CT House of Representatives includes all of Coventry, Columbia and parts of Bolton, Lebanon and Tolland. Find out if you live in District 8 and how and when you can vote for Francis Lombard for State Representative to replace Tim Ackert who is not running for re-election.
paid_for_by: Paid for by Lombard for the 8th
title: Lombard for the 8th
